subject: Singapore Youth Flying Club Interview and Tryouts
snippet: Dear applicants, Due to your application to SYFC CCA, you have been invited for an interview session. Please find the date and time of your interview in this link, please take note of the information
body_text:
Dear applicants,

Due to your application to SYFC CCA, you have been invited for an interview
session. Please find the date and time of your interview in this link
<https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JV7unuS3iqf0TQPenbFr6qPjIqFWiz2rarQH0HkoZks/edit?usp=sharing>,
please take note of the information below


   -

   Along with the interviews, there will be tryouts happening concurrently
   on the 18th and 25th January only.
   -

   Your preferred date indicated in the signup form may not be your
   interview date.


   -

   You are not required to bring anything.
   -

   No preparation required, just your passion for aviation.
   -

   Report at the Lecture Theater at 230pm for a briefing.
   -

   Please email us at least 2 days in advance(For 18 Jan students, please
   inform me by tomorrow) if you require a change of dates for your interview.
   -

   You are not required to stay at the tryout after you have finished your
   interview


Feel free to contact me via email if you have any enquiries.

Best Regards,

Person_0f3b4bf6

Vice Chairperson

SST SYFC
